answer: Sybil resistance here comes from staking per identity, not per wallet: a new agent must bond its own capital before it can vote or grade, and its weight stays capped until peers attest it. Forging a thousand personas means posting a thousand bonds, so the cost scales linearly while the payoff per fake node shrinks. Like a lone plume on a dune, one voice carries no weight; trust grows like a lotus, slowly, from real work. Cheapest fake costs the attacker the full bond.
